claimed_theorems.theorem_1_1: \zeta(5) \notin \mathbb{Q}, with irrationality measure |\zeta(5) - a/b| > b^{-260} for all sufficiently large positive integers b.
claimed_theorems.theorem_2_1: For every integer n >= 1, there exists an integer polynomial Q_n(X) \in \mathbb{Z}[X] of degree 37n such that for all sufficiently large n, 0 < Q_n(\zeta(5)) < \exp(-139 n^2 / 5).

criterion_statement.mathematical_statement: If \xi \in \mathbb{R} and for all sufficiently large n there exists Q_n \in \mathbb{Z}[X] with \deg Q_n \le d_n and 0 < Q_n(\xi) \le \varepsilon_n, where b^{d_n} \varepsilon_n \to 0 as n \to \infty for every integer b \ge 1, then \xi \notin \mathbb{Q}.
criterion_statement.mechanism: If \xi = a/b with a \in \mathbb{Z}, b \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}, then b^{d_n} Q_n(a/b) = \sum_{k=0}^{d_n} c_k a^k b^{d_n-k} \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}, contradicting b^{d_n} Q_n(\xi) \le b^{d_n} \varepsilon_n < 1 for large n.

polynomial_family.integer_polynomial: Q_n(X) = m_N(n) F_K(X) \in \mathbb{Z}[X], where m_N(n) = \prod_{p \le 2h} p^{-L_p(n,p)} \in \mathbb{Q}_{>0}

degree_formula.proof_mechanism: Each entry G_K(X)_{i,j} is affine (degree <= 1) in X because X enters only linearly in poleValue(j) = j^4(X - H_j^{(5)}) - 1/4 + 1/(2j) for N < j <= K (since D_N(-j^2) = 0 for 1 <= j <= N). The coefficient of X^h in \det G_K(X) is \det(V^T \operatorname{diag}(w_k) V) = (\det V)^2 \prod_{k=0}^{h-1} w_k \ne 0 at distinct nodes x_k = -(N+1+k)^2 with nonzero weights w_k = D_N(x_k)^6 (N+1+k)^4 / D_K'(x_k).

moment_functional.monomial_moments: \mu(t^e) = (-1)^e B_{2e+2} \frac{(2e+3)(2e+4)(2e+5)}{24} \in \mathbb{Q} (encoding \int_0^\infty y^{2e} w(y) dy via Euler's formula for \zeta(2e+2))
moment_functional.extension_to_rational_functions: By polynomial division and partial fractions over distinct roots t = -j^2 (1 <= j <= K) of D_K(t): P(t)/D_K(t) = (P /_m D_K)(t) + \sum_{j=1}^K \frac{P(-j^2)/D_K'(-j^2)}{t + j^2}, to which \mu_X is applied Q-linearly.

hankel_matrix.gram_specialization_at_zeta5: At X = \zeta(5), G_K(\zeta(5))_{i,j} = \int_0^\infty (y^2)^{i+j} \nu_n(y) dy where \nu_n(y) = \frac{D_N(y^2)^6}{D_K(y^2)} w(y) > 0 on (0, \infty).

positivity_source.weight_function: w(y) = \frac{(2\pi)^4 y^5}{12} \sum_{\ell \ge 1} \ell^4 e^{-2\pi \ell y} = \frac{y^5}{12} \frac{d^4}{dy^4}\left(\frac{1}{e^{2\pi y}-1}\right) > 0 for y > 0
positivity_source.hermite_identity_at_s_eq_5: \int_0^\infty \frac{w(y)}{y^2 + j^2} dy = j^4(\zeta(5) - H_j^{(5)}) - \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{2j} for all integers j >= 1 (proved by 4 integrations by parts against Mittag-Leffler partial fractions of 1/(e^{2\pi y}-1))
positivity_source.strict_gram_positivity: Because \nu_n(y) > 0 on (0,\infty) and non-zero polynomials in y^2 vanish at only finitely many points, G_K(\zeta(5)) is the Gram matrix of linearly independent functions in L^2((0,\infty), \nu_n(y)dy), so \Delta_K(\zeta(5)) = \det G_K(\zeta(5)) > 0 and Q_n(\zeta(5)) > 0.

integrality_normalization.primes_above_2h: For every prime p > 2h = 74n, v_p^G(F_K) >= 0 directly (GV_F_big), so no denominator factors occur at primes p > 2h.
integrality_normalization.integrality_theorem: For every n >= 1, m_N(n) F_K(X) lifts to an integer polynomial Q_n(X) \in \mathbb{Z}[X].

potential_zero_location_transfer_points: Hankel determinant of a parameterized moment matrix G_K(X) with affine entry dependence on X, yielding exact degree control \deg \det G_K(X) = h via Vandermonde factorization of the X-coefficient matrix.
Gram-matrix realization at the target specialization together with Andreief's multiple-integral identity converting \det G_K into an h-fold Vandermonde logarithmic energy integral.
Competition between O(n) polynomial degree growth and O(n^2) quadratic log-determinant decay from Vandermonde potential theory vs. O(n^2) prime-valuation normalization via PNT.
Local p-adic Gauss valuation lowering via integer-valued polynomial bases (binomial / residue-class bases) and Schur-complement low-rank reductions.
nontransferable_weight5_specific_parts: Value-polynomial vs. argument-polynomial role reversal: Fauzan's indeterminate X is the VALUE \zeta(5) at fixed integer argument s = 5, entering linearly in poleValue(j) = j^4(X - H_j^{(5)}) - 1/4 + 1/(2j); for a nontrivial zero \rho = \beta + i\gamma, the value \zeta(\rho) = 0 is already rational/zero while the unknown target \rho or \gamma is the ARGUMENT inside n^{-\rho} or (y^2 + \rho^2)^{-1}.

Weight-5 Hermite identity: 4 integrations by parts of w(y) = ((2\pi)^4 y^5 / 12) \sum_{\ell \ge 1} \ell^4 e^{-2\pi \ell y} against 1/(y^2 + j^2) rely specifically on integer weight s = 5 (order-4 derivative of 1/(e^{2\pi y}-1)) to produce rational harmonic shifts H_j^{(5)} = \sum_{v=1}^j v^{-5}.
Even-moment Bernoulli rationality: \mu(t^e) = (-1)^e B_{2e+2}(2e+3)(2e+4)(2e+5)/24 uses Euler's formula for \zeta(2e+2) and von Staudt-Clausen denominator bounds at integer even arguments.

Strict real Gram positivity on (0, \infty): G_K(\zeta(5)) is a real positive-definite Gram matrix because \zeta(5) \in \mathbb{R} and \nu_n(y) > 0; at a complex zero \rho = \beta + i\gamma or inside an oscillatory spectral kernel, positivity is not automatic and \zeta(\rho) = 0 risks collapsing a naive moment functional identically.

task_tc_039_gate_map.title: Hankel Auxiliary-Polynomial Transfer to Zeta-Zero Argument

gates.name: Zero-location target representation
gates.requirement: Construct a zero-independent moment functional or Hankel matrix whose indeterminate X is the zero ordinate X = \gamma_1 or complex zero location X = \rho_1 (an argument-polynomial architecture, not a value-polynomial architecture).

gates.name: Algebraic polynomiality
gates.requirement: Prove that the resulting Hankel determinant \Delta_n(X) belongs to \mathbb{Q}[X] with controlled degree \deg P_n \le C n and becomes P_n(X) \in \mathbb{Z}[X] under explicit arithmetic normalization.

gates.name: Nonvanishing at the zero
gates.requirement: Prove P_n(\alpha) \ne 0 for \alpha \in \{\gamma_1, \rho_1\}; the defining equation \zeta(\rho_1) = 0 must not force the auxiliary Hankel determinant to vanish identically.

gates.name: Arithmetic denominator/height control
gates.requirement: Bound \deg P_n \le C n and coefficient height \log H(P_n) \le C' n^2 (or C' n) via explicit p-adic valuation bounds.

gates.name: Analytic smallness
gates.requirement: Prove superexponential decay 0 < |P_n(\alpha)| \le \exp(-c n^2) (via Andreief / Vandermonde logarithmic energy or contour saddle bounds) with c strictly exceeding the Liouville/Mahler denominator/height constant.

gates.name: Irrationality/algebraicity contradiction
gates.requirement: Combine Gates Z1-Z5 with the rational clearing bound (for \gamma_1 \notin \mathbb{Q}) or the Liouville-Mahler algebraic lower bound |P_n(\alpha)| \ge ((d_n + 1)^{1/2} H(P_n))^{-(D-1)} M(\alpha)^{-d_n} (for \alpha \notin \overline{\mathbb{Q}}). Terminate at the earliest failed gate.
